adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff shows `group.users.delete(user_id)` followed by `if group.save ... else render_json_error(group)`. The association deletion is performed immediately by `delete`, so the subsequent `group.save` is likely redundant and often a no-op (no model attributes changed). That makes the error branch very unlikely in normal operation, and it also doesn’t handle exceptions raised by the `delete` itself. However, from the diff alone it’s not provable that `group.save` “can’t fail” (validations/callbacks could still theoretically return false), so calling it a definite bug/dead code is overstated.
